title: Stream Freely.
Donate Privately.
index.description: The real-time donation alert box built for everyone. Let your fans support your stream without revealing who you are.

steps.title: 1. Prepare Your Payment Gateway
steps.description: Ensure you have an active account with a supported provider like Stripe, Ko-fi, or Buy Me a Coffee.

steps.title: 2. Create Your Profile
steps.description: Sign up on Alertbox.org to generate your custom, privacy-focused streamer profile.

steps.title: 3. Connect via Webhook
steps.description: Link your payment gateway using our secure webhook so we can trigger alerts when you receive a donation.

steps.title: 4. Customize Your Alert Box
steps.description: Adjust the design, colors, and layout of your alerts to perfectly match your stream's aesthetic.

steps.title: 5. Add Overlay to OBS
steps.description: Copy your unique overlay URL and paste it as a Browser Source in your broadcasting software.

steps.title: 6. Go Live!
steps.description: You are all set. We handle the overlay and profile, while your funds go directly to you.

faq.q: How is EasyDonate different from us?

ezdn: EasyDonate triggers an alert only when a donor uploads a bank transfer slip for verification, and the funds are transferred directly to the streamer's bank account.
alertbox_org: However, we trigger alerts instantly when a donor makes a purchase, subscribes, or donates. Payment gateway providers like Stripe, Buy Me a Coffee, or Ko-fi send us a Webhook event to display the alert in real-time.
This method protects the streamer's personal information, as the donor pays the payment gateway provider first before the funds are ultimately transferred to the streamer.

ezdn: EasyDonate's free tier only allows up to 10 donation alerts per month and may display ads on the donation page.
Please learn more about %EasyDonate's pricing here%.
alertbox_org: We are a non-profit platform. We charge zero platform fees. The only fees you incur are those deducted directly by your chosen payment gateways (e.g., Stripe, Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi), which are entirely out of our control.
Because of this, our only source of revenue to maintain and keep Alertbox.org and tip-to.me running is through donations from our users.

disclaimer: We at AlertBox.org have no affiliation, partnership, or personal relationship with the management of EasyDonate.
AlertBox.org was created by a small group of passionate developers who share the same ideal:
"True innovation flourishes when knowledge is free"
Our intention in building AlertBox.org is not to destroy market competitors. We simply want to provide another alternative for everyone.
Built by humans, for humans, on Earth.

connections.title: Integrations
connections.description: Connect your preferred gateways. We only listen for webhooks to trigger your alerts—we never touch your money or access your banking details.

stripe.name: Stripe
stripe.description: Enterprise-grade payment gateway for accepting credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay globally.
stripe.privacy: Highest. Viewers pay on Stripe's secure checkout. Alertbox.org only receives a webhook notification without any of your sensitive banking data.
stripe.payout: Direct to your bank account based on your Stripe payout schedule.

kofi.name: Ko-fi
kofi.description: A popular, zero-fee platform for creators to receive one-time donations and subscriptions.
kofi.privacy: Strong. Donors interact with your Ko-fi username, keeping your real identity safe. We simply read the alert signal.
kofi.payout: Instant. Funds go directly to your connected PayPal or Stripe account.

bmac.name: Buy Me a Coffee
bmac.description: A fast, friendly way for fans to support your stream with a simple checkout experience.
bmac.privacy: Strong. Viewers donate on your public creator page. Alertbox.org only processes the notification payload to show the alert.
bmac.payout: Directly to your bank account via standard Buy Me a Coffee payout methods.

xendit.name: Xendit
xendit.description: Leading payment gateway in Southeast Asia, optimized for local bank transfers, e-wallets, and cards.
xendit.privacy: Highest. Viewers pay on Xendit's secure checkout. Alertbox.org only receives a webhook notification without any of your sensitive banking data.
xendit.payout: Direct to your bank account based on your Xendit payout schedule.

omise.name: Omise
omise.description: A leading payment gateway in Southeast Asia, supporting a wide range of local and international payment methods.
omise.privacy: Highest. Viewers pay on Omise's secure checkout. Alertbox.org only receives a webhook notification without any of your sensitive banking data.
omise.payout: Direct to your bank account based on your Omise payout schedule.

2c2p.name: 2C2P
2c2p.description: Comprehensive payment platform helping businesses accept payments from across Southeast Asia and beyond.
2c2p.privacy: Highest. Viewers pay on 2C2P's secure checkout. Alertbox.org only receives a webhook notification without any of your sensitive banking data.
2c2p.payout: Direct to your bank account based on your 2C2P payout schedule.

feelfreepay.name: FeelFreePay
feelfreepay.description: Seamless payment gateway optimized for quick and easy local transactions and QR codes.
feelfreepay.privacy: High. Alertbox.org only listens for the successful transaction signal to trigger your alert without accessing your financial data.
feelfreepay.payout: Funds collected from donors are processed and can be withdrawn to your registered bank account on a weekly basis.

youtube.name: YouTube
youtube.description: Receive alerts for new subscribers, channel memberships, and Super Chats.
youtube.privacy: Strong. We only monitor for new events. We never access your private channel data or personal information.

facebook.name: Facebook
facebook.description: Get real-time alerts for new followers, stars, and supporters on your Facebook Gaming page.
facebook.privacy: High. Alertbox.org only listens for event notifications. Your account remains private and secure.

twitch.name: Twitch
twitch.description: Connect your Twitch channel for alerts on new followers, subscriptions, and bits.
twitch.privacy: Strong. We only read the stream event signals. Your Twitch account security is never compromised.

patreon.name: Patreon
patreon.description: Automate your alerts for new patrons and membership tier updates.
patreon.privacy: High. We only receive notification of new support. We do not have access to your patron lists or payment details.

streamlabs.name: Streamlabs
streamlabs.description: Forward your donation alerts to Streamlabs to trigger their widgets and integrations.
streamlabs.privacy: Strong. We only send the alert payload to your Streamlabs socket token. Your account remains secure.

footer.description:
Alertbox.org is an open-source alert box service featuring custom streamer profiles, zero platform fees, and robust privacy protection. 
Powered by trusted payment gateways like Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi, and Stripe.
